notes: Personal use unless we agree otherwise.
Fan art and original characters are both welcome.
Turnaround depends on the queue; ask and I will tell you where it stands.

steps.title: Send the idea
steps.text: Who or what, the mood, and any reference pictures you have.

steps.title: Quote and pencils
steps.text: You get a price, then a pencil drawing to approve before any ink goes on.

steps.title: Inks and colours
steps.text: The piece is inked and coloured, with progress shots along the way.

steps.title: Delivery
steps.text: A high-resolution file lands in your inbox, ready to print or post.

intro: Your favourite character, your own character, or a cover for your book, drawn in my style. Tell me what you have in mind.

tiers.name: Sketch
tiers.text: A pencil drawing of one character, like the ones I post.

tiers.name: Inked piece
tiers.text: One character, pencilled and inked in black and white.

tiers.name: Full colour
tiers.text: Pencils, inks and colours. Room for more than one character or a background.

tiers.name: Cover or pages
tiers.text: A cover or sequential pages for your own comic.

title: Get something drawn
closedText: The books are closed for now. Send the idea anyway and you will hear back when a slot opens.
